title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 23 September 2026
description: Today: the big four banks now forecast an RBA rate rise next week as Canberra schools brace for a delayed Thursday start; Brisbane sets up a blockbuster NRLW preliminary final against Gold Coast; and Cbus Super Stadium in Robina gears up to host Sunday's showdown. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
